description: §19.10.4 — a `transaction { }` block inside a function that is NOT declared `!` is E-ERROR-001. Pre-S450 the block did not parse in a function body at all (E-SCOPE-001 on `transaction`); `notCodes` pins that the block is now recognised and rejected for the governed reason.
rationale: §19.10.4: "`transaction { }` SHALL be valid only inside `!` functions. Using `transaction` in a non-`!` function SHALL be a compile error (E-ERROR-001 applies)."
